defs.def: the raised flat area beside the track at a train station where you get on or off the train 站台；月台

ex.s: Many stations have wheelchair access from the car park or entrance to the station platforms.
ex.t: 如需协助，请致电昆士兰铁路13 16 17。

defs.def: a flat surface raised above the level of the ground or floor, used by public speakers or performers so that the audience can see them 讲台；舞台
a raised level surface, for example one that equipment stands on or is operated from 平台

ex.s: Community Services: support communities by providing upcycled goods to those in need and help promote projects through social platforms to widen outreach.
ex.t: 社区服务：通过向有需要的人提供升级改造的物品来支持社区，并通过社交平台帮助推广项目以扩大影响范围。

ex.s: set up social platformsD. promote language learning
ex.t: 建立社交平台。D.促进语言学习。

ex.s: Meet on the lower platform at Artist Point on the South Rim Drive for this short talk.
ex.t: 在南缘车道 Artist Point 的下层平台集合，参加这场简短讲座。

ex.s: Handshake is an online job search platform for college students.
ex.t: Handshake是一个面向大学生的在线求职平台。

ex.s: The popularity of these platforms is spreading globally
ex.t: 这些平台的普及正在全球传播

ex.s: An easy way to bring all work generations together is with a chat platform
ex.t: 让各年龄段职场人聚在一起的一个简便方式是使用聊天平台

ex.s: Merit and his team at Environmental Design installed underneath the root ball a platform of seven-inch-diameter,44-foot-long steelbars and, just below the rods, a first set of uninflated airbags ( shown in gray).The team also dug a shallow ramp.
ex.t: 环境设计公司的梅里特及其团队在根球下方安装了一个平台，由直径7英寸、长44英尺的钢条构成，钢条正下方是第一组未充气的气囊（灰色所示）。团队还挖了一条浅坡道。

ex.s: Using the first set of airbags, the movers rolled the platform into the new hole.
ex.t: 白色气囊然后在约半小时内放气以将巨杉的根球降到坑底，气囊被移走了，但钢棒留在了树上因为它们会在数年内生锈降解。

ex.s: Tourists can stand on a narrow glass platform called the Skywalk to see the Grand Canyon.
ex.t: 游客可以站在一个叫空中走廊的狭窄玻璃平台上观看大峡谷。

ex.s: World Oceans Day provides them with a platform where they can express their concerns and share their ideas.
ex.t: 世界海洋日为他们提供了一个表达关切和分享想法的平台。

ex.s: By underinflating the front bags, the team allowed the platform carrying the tree to roll up the ramp and out of the hole while staying level, A trailer hauled the tree along as team members removed the airbags from the back of the platform and replaced them in the front.
ex.t: 通过给前袋少充气，团队让载树的平台在保持水平的情况下滚上坡道出坑，拖车拖着树前行，成员们从平台后方取下气囊补到前方。

ex.s: Whether it’s an online shop where we can hire designer clothes at rock-bottom prices, or a platform from which we can rent out our flats for a couple of days, it’s out there.
ex.t: 无论是在网上商店我们可以以极低的价格租用设计师服装，还是一个我们可以把公寓出租几天的平台，它都已经存在了。

ex.s: There are also social media platforms to help the students work together on projects, and online “worlds” where the students can interact with each other and the digital environment while completing different learning tasks.
ex.t: 还有社交媒体平台帮助学生们一起完成项目，以及在线＂世界＂，学生在完成不同学习任务的同时可以与彼此和数字环境互动。

ex.s: Sharing platforms collect personal information about almost every part of our lives, including our names, locations, bank information, and individual preferences for goods and services.
ex.t: 共享平台收集有关我们生活几乎每个方面的个人信息，包括我们的名字、位置、银行信息以及对商品和服务的个人偏好。

defs.def: the aims of a political party and the things that they say they will do if they are elected to power （政党的）纲领，政纲，宣言
an opportunity or a place for sb to express their opinions publicly or make progress in a particular area （公开表达意见或在某方面发展的）机会，阵地，讲坛
the type of computer system or the software that is used 计算机平台
a type of shoe with a high, thick sole; the sole on such a shoe 厚底鞋；厚鞋底
the open part at the back of a double-decker bus where you get on or off （双层汽车的）上下车出入口，入口平台
